phase_name: Decode canonical .md and apply punctuation cleanup

objectives.description: Run Phase 1 decoder on canonical .md in place, write flag report
Inspect flag report and hand-check ambiguous 0 occurrences
Spot-read decoded canonical: title page, chapter headings, mid-document region

deviations.description: Phase 3 plan step: 'Inspect the flag report; hand-check each isolated ambiguous 0 (expected very few / zero per report survey) and resolve or leave with a documented note.'
deviations.reason: The full-document sweep produced 717 rule-4 flagged occurrences (of 2163 total decoded-0 occurrences: 1394 resolved to periods via tiers 1-2, 52 left as genuine digits via tier 3, 717 unresolved), far more than the report's small-sample estimate of 'very few / zero'. Individually hand-checking 717 occurrences is infeasible and falls into the over-engineering the plan's Non-Goals explicitly warns against for math/logic notation residuals. Instead: (a) categorized the 717 by pattern -- ~351 are space-separated multi-dot mathematical ellipsis sequences (e.g. 'P1, 0 0 0, Pn' meaning 'P1, ..., Pn'), ~366 are sentence-final periods immediately following a formula symbol/quote mark rather than a letter; (b) spot-checked for any pattern resembling a genuine numeric zero (grep for '= 0', 'zero') and found only 3 candidates, all of which on inspection are the same ellipsis/formula-period pattern, not genuine digit zeros -- consistent with the report's core empirical finding of zero confirmed genuine numeric zeros; (c) left all 717 in place as documented residuals rather than guessing, per the plan's own tier-4 instruction ('leave in place AND emit to flag-report for manual review').
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — 717 residuals categorized and spot-checked rather than individually hand-checked; documented as known math-notation-adjacent limitation, consistent with report's zero-genuine-zeros finding)*

deviations.description: Additional finding during spot-read (not a deviation from a specific plan step, but worth recording): a further, narrower residual pattern was observed -- single-digit theorem/lemma/section citation numbers immediately followed by a sentence-final period (e.g. 'Theorem 4.', 'Theorem II.3.') decode as 'theorem 4 0' / 'Theorem II.30' because the ambiguous trailing 0 is digit-adjacent (tier 3: leave as genuine digit) rather than letter-adjacent (tier 2: period). This is an inherent, previously-undocumented consequence of the validated four-tier rule's tier-3 assumption (digit-touching 0 = real digit) applied to single-digit citation numbers, not a bug in the decoder. Recorded as an accepted limitation in the implementation summary.
deviations.reason: Falls within the plan's explicit math/logic-notation residual scope; the plan instructs not to over-engineer fixes for these. No cipher or tier-rule change was made.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: deferred to summary residuals section — theorem/lemma numbering + trailing-period ambiguity documented as accepted limitation)*
